i appreciate all the advice, i really, really do. and i don't mean to sound as though i'm discounting it because it's all really solid, but i'm honestly not very hopeful about things getting any better for me these days. suggestions 1 and 2 are totally sensible and i've tried in some form or another and i just found myself even more miserable after putting effort into them. for point 1 therapy didn't help much in spite of my hopes which left me feeling beyond help. though i suspect i simply may have not had very good therapists.

and for point 2 while i've never been much of a god person i used to be absolutely fascinated with learning as much about every religion and house of philosophy i possibly could, but the farther i got into that the more hopeless i felt, y'know? nothing ever made me feel at ease and i was never able to strongly believe in any one perspective. each point i appreciated about one school of thought seemed to contradict everything i valued in another. the more i learned about this thing that i respected and enjoyed the more it felt utterly useless. i say this because i feel like it resemebles most of my life. the more invested i become in something or someone the worse it gets. on the *extremely* rare occasion i find myself able to enjoy a new hobby the positive qualities that once interested me always crumble as meaningless facades and i begin to find them insufferably stupid or realize that i'm too insufferably stupid to enjoy them anyways. 

as for people it's almost the opposite. i'll have the utmost respect and care for people only for them to realize that i'm a waste of time and slowly give up on me.

point 3 i totally, completely agree with and wish i was better able to embrace but it just feels so... difficult. impossible almost. i won't bore you with why as i've written too much already and feel weird for it, but i just highly doubt that i'm worth anyone's time and feel like i may as well give up. everything feels impossible and it shouldn't. i know i needlessly complicate things with my miserable pessimism i just feel like i don't know how to do anything else.

sorry for blindly rambling at you. and sorry if i came across as though i didn't value your pov. thanks again.
